title: Qing Tan's Yin Dan and the Road to Great Desolate Province
summary: Elder Shen attacks, and Little Mink spends its newly restored power through the Stone Talisman, using Pure Yuan Pills, to hold him off and tells Lin Dong to run. When Elder Shen's Black Light Blade is about to kill him, Ling Qingzhu saves him, and Wang Yan calls Elder Shen off. She makes Lin Dong swear never to speak of the tomb and warns that the secret could destroy even the Lin Clan. When he says he will one day be worthy of her, she tells him to first earn a place in the Hundred Dynasties Battle. Back in Yan City, Lin Dong uses the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva to help Qing Tan condense her Yin Dan. He burns away the Fiend Devil Qi with Myriad Transformation Flame until Qing Tan masters it herself. Her cold poison is gone, she leaps to Yuan Dan perfect, and Lin Dong sets out for Great Desolate Province, promising to return for the Lin Clan Gathering in two years.
events: Elder Shen attacks; Little Mink burns its restored power through the Stone Talisman to blunt him.
Lin Dong uses the halberd against Elder Shen's Black Light Blade and is nearly killed.
Ling Qingzhu saves Lin Dong; Wang Yan tells Elder Shen not to chase.
Ling Qingzhu swears Lin Dong to secrecy and mentions the Hundred Dynasties Battle.
In Yan City, Lin Dong uses the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva to help Qing Tan form her Yin Dan.
The Fiend Devil Qi takes shape; Lin Dong drives it back with Myriad Transformation Flame, and Qing Tan subdues it.
Qing Tan's cold poison is cured and she breaks through to Yuan Dan perfect.
Lin Dong leaves Yan City for Great Desolate Province.
cultivation: Qing Tan condenses her Yin Dan and breaks through to Yuan Dan perfect at once.
